description: This file defines the Struct SingleSegmentBuffer, implementing the IBufferWriter<byte> interface, managing a byte buffer with methods for writing, accessing, and resetting its contents.

classes.name: SingleSegmentBuffer
classes.description: A struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> that manages a pre-allocated byte array buffer, allowing for efficient writing and access.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the write position by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> starting at the current write position, with an optional size hint.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> starting at the current write position, with a specified size hint.

methods.name: ToArray
methods.description: Returns the written portion of the buffer as a new byte array.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer to an empty state.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: A property returning the number of bytes written to the buffer.

methods.name: GetReadOnlySpan
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySpan<byte> over the written data.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the written buffer content to a UTF-8 string.
